source: RocketCEA 1.2.3 via repository backend; CoolProp 8.0.0 HEOS n-dodecane

gas.source: Real LOX/RP-1 RocketCEA chamber transport; SI conversion in repository RocketCEABackend
gas.validity: Chamber transport is independent of expansion ratio. Not local nozzle transport; a thermal correlation using these properties remains an approximation.
gas.frozenTransport: cpFrozenJkgK, prandtlFrozen and kFrozenWmK come from CEA get_Chamber_Transport(frozen=1) through the repository backend. muPaS is common to both modes. gammaFrozen is derived as cpFrozen/(cpFrozen-R), R=universal gas constant/chamber molecular weight, for a fixed-composition calorically-perfect local-flow approximation. Equilibrium chamber gamma and transport remain separately available; model selection must be explicit.

validation.method: direct CEA versus bilinear interpolation at every pc/OF cell midpoint
validation.limitation: Sampled interpolation errors, not a global bound or experimental validation.

coolant.source: CoolProp 8.0.0 HEOS::n-Dodecane; freshly evaluated, no reference-data clamping

validity.interpolation: bilinear T,p only when all nonzero-weight corner states are valid; no extrapolation
validity.phaseBoundary: No interpolation across null/vapor states. Valid rectangular cells stay on the dense-liquid side of the saturation boundary.
validity.enthalpy: Absolute values depend on reference state and can be negative; use differences. cp is the EOS derivative at constant pressure.
limitations: Single-component n-dodecane is not an RP-1 mixture model or qualified RP-1 data.
No pyrolysis, coking, boiling or two-phase transport model.
Not an official NIST or REFPROP export.

validation.method: direct CoolProp versus bilinear interpolation at each fully valid cell midpoint
validation.limitation: Interpolation checks only; no evidence of RP-1 surrogate accuracy.

references.title: CoolProp n-dodecane EOS and transport references
Lemmon and Huber, Thermodynamic Properties of n-Dodecane (2004)
Huber, Laesecke and Perkins, Transport Properties of n-Dodecane (2004)
NIST RP-1 surrogate mixture research: distinct from this single-component proxy
